bots.name: Sunny Gold
bots.strategy: Watches gold every hour and follows the big trend: it buys when gold has risen over the last few months and bets on a drop when gold has fallen. A safety stop sells automatically if a trade goes wrong.
context: Gold fell 1.2% in the last day, to $4,265.
Gold is below its recent average - the trend is down.
The US dollar got stronger today - that usually pushes gold down.
US interest rates rose today - usually bad for gold.
No big US news left this week.
News: Gold Two-Week Plunge Puts August Breakout to the Test
News: Gold loses shine as rate hike bets foster a stronger dollar

bots.name: Sunny Gold Fast
bots.strategy: Checks gold every 5 minutes and makes quick trades, but only in the direction gold has been moving for the last two months. A safety stop limits each loss. In testing this lost money - watch it, don't trust it yet.
